facts.fact: The FCCPC says the Digital, Electronic, Online and Non-Traditional Consumer Lending Regulations, 2025 (DEON) apply to digital money lending operators, with a regularisation deadline of 5 January 2026.

The FCCPC says it began enforcement on 21 January 2026, withdrawing conditional approval from digital lenders that missed the DEON deadline and removing them from its published register of approved lenders.
